# scrutari_domain (Data Source)

Look up a single domain-verification row by id. Today's verification flow is dashboard-mediated; this data source is read-only. When `POST /v1/domains` ships, a `scrutari_domain` resource will follow.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Domain verification id.

### Read-Only

- `attempts` (Number) Count of verification attempts the gateway has run for this row. The rate-limiter backs off after repeated failures.
- `challenge_host` (String) DNS host the customer creates the verification record on (e.g. `_scrutari-challenge.api.acme-corp.com` for `dns_txt`).
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of when the verification row was created (= when the challenge was issued).
- `domain` (String) The hostname being verified (e.g. `api.acme-corp.com`). Case-folded on the server side.
- `expires_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp after which this verification row no longer counts as proof of control (default: 7 days from creation).
- `last_error` (String) Most recent verification error message, if any. `null` when the last attempt succeeded or no attempts have run yet.
- `status` (String) Current verification state — one of `pending` / `verified` / `failed` / `expired`.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant that owns this domain. Derived from the caller's authenticated key; read-only.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent verification attempt or state change.
- `verification_type` (String) `dns_txt` or `cname` — which DNS record family proves control of the domain.
- `verified_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp the verification succeeded; `null` until verified (or after expiry).
